name: pet-rock
description: An on-chain Tamagotchi. Raise a pixel-art rock that lives on Hedera.

scripts.setup:assets: curl -L -o /tmp/kenney.zip "https://www.kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/pixel-platformer/33bb4921eb-1696667883/kenney_pixel-platformer.zip" && unzip -o /tmp/kenney.zip -d /tmp/kenney/ && mkdir -p public/assets/kenney && cp -r /tmp/kenney/*/Tiles public/assets/kenney/ && cp -r /tmp/kenney/*/Characters public/assets/kenney/ && echo "Kenney assets installed."
